system.description:
You build up chakra into the palm of your hand, until each time you flex your fingers the air crackles with thunderous booms.

Make a melee taijutsu attack against a creature you can see within range, on a hit you deal your [Unarmed damage] + 6d4 and the target must make a Constitution saving throw being Dazed on a failed save until the end of their next turn.

Finisher: Make a melee taijutsu attack. On a hit, you deal your [Unarmed damage] + 10d4. You treat Barriers and intercepting structures as vulnerable to this jutsu’s damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 2d4. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, a creature that fails their saving throw become Bruised. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, if you make a clash check, add your unarmed damage die to the result. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, if you succeed a clash, the losing creature becomes Stunned until the end of their next turn.
